g.text: AUC; .5 = chance ranking. Higher score predicts larger error; directions are never flipped.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: Case-balanced AUC: midpoint error norm > .10 m
Retrospective known/new seed-cohort comparison; fixed score directions
S: simultaneous audited pair; L: lagged pre/post pair. Row labels show matched/requested references. Grey NA: an outcome class is absent.
Lagged |D| uses known truth motion and is an oracle diagnostic. Cases are equally weighted within each reporting group.
Both seed cohorts were observed previously. No calibrated probability, confidence interval or new release/controller is claimed.
